What's in Listerine that's from thyme?
Thymol — a monoterpene phenol with broad antimicrobial activity. Active in original formula (1879).
What's the difference between oregano and marjoram?
Same genus (Origanum) but different species and chemistry. Marjoram (O. majorana) = milder, floral (linalool). Oregano = pungent (carvacrol).
Why is dried basil so much weaker than fresh?
Basil volatiles (linalool, eugenol, methyl chavicol) are unstable — dried basil loses most within weeks
What's the "maple syrup" compound in fenugreek?
Sotolon — absorbed from gut, excreted via sweat/urine. Same compound that gives maple syrup urine disease its name.
Physical damage merges compartments: alliin + alliinase → allicin → diallyl disulfide/trisulfide (the actual garlic aroma)
Why doesn't cooking garlic produce as much allicin as raw?
Heat denatures alliinase → enzyme can't convert alliin → milder flavor
Why is sage a concern in supplement form?
Thujone content (15–35% of EO) — GABAA antagonist; safe in culinary use, risky in concentrated supplements or essential oil
